resources.string: PSX-DS reads your games from your ROM folder and keeps its save states, screenshots, cheats and game logos in a \"PSX-DS\" folder on your storage. Android calls the permission for that \"All files access\".\n\nOn the next screen, switch it on for PSX-DS, then come back.
PSX-DS needs \"All files access\" to read your ROM folder. Switch it on, then come back.
